Monotonic stack of indices. O(n).

For largest rect hist stack I will push indices and pop when a smaller height appears.

```python
def largest(h):
    stack = []
    out = 0
    for i, x in enumerate(h + [0]):
        while stack and h[stack[-1]] > x:
            j = stack.pop()
            w = i if not stack else i - stack[-1] - 1
            out = max(out, h[j] * w)
        stack.append(i)
    return out
```
